**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Lost Partition Rescue)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** Maximized, 1024x768 resolution. Standard Windows 11 chrome.
*   **Title Bar Strip (0–40px):**
    *   App Icon/Text (Left): [0, 0] to [240, 40]
    *   Utility Icons (Right): [670, 0] to [880, 40]
    *   Window Controls (Far Right): [900, 0] to [1024, 40]
*   **Sidebar (Navigation Pane) (0, 40) to (280, 950):**
    *   Width: ~280px. Background is light grey/blue-tinted.
    *   Sections: "Data Recovery", "Advanced Features", "File Backup".
    *   Items: Vertically stacked list with icons and text.
    *   Selected Item: "Lost Partition Rescue" has a light blue background highlight spanning the full width of the sidebar.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 40) to (1024, 950):**
    *   Background: White card/container centered with margins or filling the right pane.
    *   Header Region (300, 70) to (980, 180): Title "Lost Partition Rescue" and subtitle.
    *   Options List (300, 250) to (750, 700): Three distinct rows for partition recovery types. Left-aligned text, left-aligned icons.
    *   Illustration Area (680, 300) to (990, 680): Large vector illustration of a hard drive platter and a mascot character.
    *   Action Footer (300, 760) to (480, 820): "Start" button positioned bottom-left of the content area.

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Sidebar - Section Headers:**
    *   "Data Recovery"
    *   "Advanced Features"
    *   "File Backup"
*   **Sidebar - Items:**
    *   "Hardware Disk"
    *   "SD Card"
    *   "More Recovery Tools"
    *   "File Repair"
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue"
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup"
*   **Main Area - Header:**
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue"
    *   "Instantly recover missing or damaged partitions"
*   **Main Area - Options:**
    *   **Option 1 Title:** "Partition Missing"
    *   **Option 1 Desc:** "Recover partitions showing as “Unallocated Space” or “RAW” in Disk Management"
    *   **Option 2 Title:** "Partition Cannot Be Opened"
    *   **Option 2 Desc:** "Fix partitions displaying “Access Denied” or “Format Required” prompts"
    *   **Option 3 Title:** "BitLocker Partition Missing/Damaged"
    *   **Option 3 Desc:** "Repair lost or corrupted BitLocker partitions"
*   **Button:** "Start"

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/Sidebar BG: `#F5F8FA` (Very light blue-grey)
    *   Main Content Card BG: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Sidebar Selection Highlight: `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Titles): `#1F2329` (Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Descriptions): `#5F6670` (Dark Grey)
    *   Sidebar Text (Normal): `#333333`
    *   Sidebar Text (Selected): `#165DFF` (Bright Blue)
*   **Accents & Controls:**
    *   Primary Button BG: `#165DFF` (Vibrant Blue)
    *   Primary Button Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Success Checkmark (Hardware Disk): `#00B42A` (Green)
*   **Borders/Lines:**
    *   Subtle dividers or card edges likely `#EEEEEE` or transparent with shadow.

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading ("Lost Partition Rescue"):** ~24px – 28px, Weight: Bold (600-700), Sans-Segoe UI / Inter style.
*   **Subtitle ("Instantly recover..."):** ~14px – 16px, Weight: Regular (400), Color: Grey.
*   **Option Titles ("Partition Missing"):** ~16px – 18px, Weight: Semi-Bold (600).
*   **Option Descriptions:** ~13px – 14px, Weight: Regular (400), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Sidebar Items:** ~14px, Weight: Regular (500 when selected).
*   **Button Text:** ~15px, Weight: Medium (500).

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~48px – 52px.
*   **Sidebar Icon Size:** 24x24px.
*   **Option Row Spacing:** ~30px – 40px vertical gap between items.
*   **Option Icon Size:** Circular container ~44px diameter. Inner icon ~24px.
*   **Button Dimensions:** Width ~160px, Height ~44px. Border Radius: ~6px – 8px.
*   **Content Padding:** Left/Right padding in main area ~40px. Top padding ~50px.
*   **Illustration:** Approx 350x400px, positioned absolute or floated right.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (Lost Partition Rescue):**
    *   **State:** Selected / Active.
    *   **Indicator:** Light blue background (`#E6F0FF`), Blue text color (`#165DFF`), Blue icon color. Vertical blue bar (accent line) on the left edge (~3px wide).
*   **Sidebar List Item (Hardware Disk):**
    *   **State:** Normal / Available.
    *   **Indicator:** Green checkmark badge on the right side.
*   **Primary Action Button ("Start"):**
    *   **Type:** Filled Button (CTA).
    *   **State:** Normal (Enabled). Solid blue background, white text. No visible hover state in static image, but implies clickability.
*   **Radio/Selection Logic (Implicit):** The three options (Partition Missing, etc.) act like a selectable list, though no radio button circle is explicitly visible; the row itself is the hit target. Currently, none appear visually "checked" with a dot, suggesting a "Select then Click Start" flow or they are just informational steps leading to the same scan.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Vector, "Filled" style with slight gradients or solid colors. Friendly/Rounded geometry.
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Drive icon (Grey).
    *   SD Card: SD Card icon (Grey).
    *   More Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver (Grey).
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool (Grey).
    *   Lost Partition: Life preserver / Ring buoy (Blue, Active).
    *   ChronoSnap: Clock/History loop (Grey).
*   **Option Icons (Circular Backgrounds):**
    *   Partition Missing: Warning triangle with exclamation mark inside a clock/circle.
    *   Partition Cannot Be Opened: Lock icon inside a clock/circle.
    *   BitLocker: Key icon inside a clock/circle.
*   **Mascot/Illustration:** A stylized character (blue/white) next to a 3D-looking disk platter. The platter has shaded segments (grey and blue).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Screen**. This is the entry point for the "Lost Partition Rescue" module. It is waiting for user input (implicit selection of a scenario) and confirmation via the "Start" button.
*   **System State:** Windows Desktop is visible (Taskbar shows time 7:59 PM, date 10/17/2026). App is maximized. No loading spinners, error toasts, or modal dialogs are present.
